tagline: A regional bank providing comprehensive financial services including lending, deposits, and treasury management
hero_kpi_rationale: Key profitability indicator for shareholders, reflecting the ability to generate returns on tangible common equity.

kpis.name: Pre-provision Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues minus operating expenses, before loan loss provisions.
kpis.description: Key banking performance metric reflecting profitability before credit risk.
kpis.signal: Solid growth in operating income in 2025

kpis.name: Net Income to Common
kpis.explanation: Net income after taxes and preferred dividends, available to common shareholders.
kpis.description: Reflection of the group's overall performance after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.signal: Significant rebound in net income in 2025

kpis.name: Tangible Common Equity
kpis.explanation: Common equity after deducting goodwill and intangible assets.
kpis.description: Measure of financial strength excluding intangible assets.

kpis.name: Tangible Assets
kpis.explanation: Total assets minus goodwill and intangible assets.
kpis.description: Base of the bank's productive tangible assets.

kpis.name: Return on Tangible Common Equity
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by average tangible common equity, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Key performance indicator for shareholders reflecting capital efficiency.

kpis.name: Book Value per Common Share
kpis.explanation: Common equity divided by the number of shares outstanding.
kpis.signal: Increase in book value per share

kpis.short: Tangible Book Value per Common Share
kpis.name: Tangible Book Value per Common Share
kpis.explanation: Tangible common equity divided by the number of shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Stricter measure of per-share value excluding intangible assets.
kpis.signal: Growth in tangible book value per share

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $3.419 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Dividends per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividends per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.17 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.34 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 34.6% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Earnings per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: used as the basis for calculating the Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Preferred Dividends Take Priority
risks.summary: The company must pay all dividends on preferred shares before any distributions to common shareholders, limiting financial flexibility.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned first in the 1A, with binding language (must pay). It directly affects the ability to pay common dividends or repurchase shares, potentially discouraging investors. The absolute priority of preferred dividends creates significant financial pressure during cash flow difficulties. The Capital category is highly weighted here.

risks.title: Regulatory Barriers to Acquisition
risks.summary: Federal and local laws, as well as statutory provisions, make a takeover of the company difficult or unattractive.
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights multiple layers of restrictions (Tennessee law, federal regulatory approval, statutory provisions). The language clearly indicates a deterrent effect on takeovers, even if beneficial. This risk is stable but critical as it may block major strategic opportunities. The Regulation category is heavily impacted.

risks.title: Exclusive Forum Clauses Limiting Legal Recourse
risks.summary: Shareholders are required to bring legal disputes in specific courts, which may limit their access to justice.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is described with precise language regarding limitations on legal remedies. Although the text notes uncertainty about applicability to federal laws, the clauses are binding. This may deter litigation but also expose the company to governance criticism. The Litigation category is moderately weighted.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: The company explicitly acknowledges risks related to cyberattacks, with dedicated treatment in the annual report.
risks.score_rationale: A dedicated item (Item 1C) is included in the 10-K, indicating heightened risk recognition. Although details are incorporated by reference, the creation of a specific section signals high intensity. In 2025, this risk is strategic for financial institutions. The Cybersecurity category is heavily weighted.

risks.title: Dependence on Executive Leadership
risks.summary: Management relies heavily on D. Bryan Jordan, whose departure could disrupt strategy and governance.
risks.score_rationale: D. Bryan Jordan's employment is governed by a contract through 2028, including an exception to retirement policy. Concentration of power in a single individual, notably as President, CEO, and Chairman, creates a governance risk. The language is neutral but the facts are significant. The Key Person category is moderately weighted.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence in the report.
